item.title: Media Losses Cloud Empire: MrBeast’s $5bn business leans on his fame; long-term durability in doubt
item.description: MrBeast has transformed his YouTube fame into a business empire valued at $5 billion, spanning chocolate, television and financial technology. His Feastables brand generated $250 million in sales and over $20 million in profit in 2024. However, his media business lost nearly $80 million despite strong revenue. With major investor backing and a fintech acquisition reaching seven million users, MrBeast faces the challenge of turning online popularity into sustainable, profitable businesses.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: 'He put it back': Trump says Ukraine's Starlink restored, stays silent on Musk
item.description: Ukraine depends heavily on Starlink for communications between military units, coordinating operations and receiving early warnings during Russian missile attacks. The satellite-based network also supports the use of drones, which Ukraine deploys both to strike Russian targets and to defend against incoming attacks. Disruptions to connectivity can therefore affect the military's ability to operate drones and respond to Russian assaults.

item.title: Goose Creek Estate Listed: Quirky 1958 ranch hits market at $1.227 million; licensed short-term rental
item.description: Nestled at 108 Hampton Avenue, this unique property in Goose Creek is now on the market. It boasts three distinct kitchens, creatively themed bedrooms, and a generous indoor pool. Spanning 5,390 square feet, this estate is perfect for multigenerational families or as a lucrative short-term rental option. The outdoor spaces are ideal for entertaining.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Necklace nearly sold for £15 at car boot sale fetches £99,000 at auction
item.description: Imagine a dusty car boot sale where a unique necklace fashioned from human hair and whale bone was nearly sold for just £15. Fortunately, it caught the eye of an expert at Ewbank's auction house, revealing its immense worth, which fetched an incredible £99,000 at auction. This story underscores the vital role of appraisals in recognizing hidden treasures that often go unnoticed in clearance sales.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Collisions Fall After Wildlife Overpass: I-25 crossings cut crashes by up to 91%; Colorado plans six more
item.description: A network of wildlife crossings in Colorado has reduced collisions along Interstate 25 by approximately 85 percent. This system includes fencing, underpasses, and an overpass which opened in December 2025. Recent studies show a significant decline in wildlife-related crashes since the introduction of these measures. Various species, including elk and pronghorn, have begun using these crossings effectively.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: After 2005 rat removal, three seabird species on a Pacific island grew up to tenfold over decades
item.description: The successful eradication of invasive rodents in 2005 has greatly influenced seabird populations on Surprise Island. Researchers closely monitored seven seabird species to document their recovery post-eradication. While some species thrived quickly, others needed more extended observation to show signs of improvement. Notably, noddies saw a significant increase in breeding pairs, whereas red-footed boobies showed a more gradual recovery.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Vanessa Hudgens bought a 1922 LA home for $5 million; after renovation, she sold it for $6.7 million
item.description: In 2018, Vanessa Hudgens acquired a charming historic residence in Los Angeles from Gary Oldman for almost $5 million. She renovated and redesigned the space, ultimately selling it to Ronan Farrow and Jon Lovett in February 2022 for an impressive $6.725 million. The 1922-built house, fondly known as Little DeMille, boasted rich heritage, beautiful gardens, and artistic enhancements by Hudgens, showcasing her flair for style.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Ellis Building Hotel Conversion: Aperture buys site for $10.3m; Marriott Tribute Portfolio rooms planned
item.description: The iconic Ellis Building, erected in 1922, is set to undergo a transformation into a chic boutique hotel, managed by Aperture Hotels and affiliated with Marriott's Tribute Portfolio. This revitalization aims to breathe new life into the historic space, following previous redevelopment failures. The project promises about 95 to 105 stylish guest rooms, complemented by a modern restaurant and bar, aligning with similar projects in downtown Phoenix.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Engineer Builds Rental Business: Ohio couple turns cave into cash; social media drives bookings
item.description: Bryant Gingerich and his wife Amy turned a sprawling 34-acre land into a thriving hospitality destination known as Dunlap Hollow. This charming getaway features an array of unique accommodations, including a quaint cottage, an A-frame, and an adventurous cave stay. By leveraging social media marketing, they attracted a steady stream of guests, leading to impressive profits.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Roe 8 Corridor Rehabilitation: 200,000 plants and 97 species return; ecosystem only 30% restored
item.description: Almost ten years post the controversial Roe 8 highway initiative, Western Australia is witnessing a promising wave of ecological recovery. Recent studies have reported a remarkable resurgence of local wildlife and native plant life. Rehabilitation efforts, which have culminated in planting over 280,000 seedlings, are welcoming back species such as Carnaby’s black cockatoos.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Olivia Wilde sells Studio City home for nearly $1m less than asking
item.description: Olivia Wilde recently offloaded her Studio City residence for $5.23 million, a price tag that fell short of her original purchase. Designed by architect Barbara Bestor, the home boasted a sleek modern-ranch aesthetic. Initially on the market for $6.2 million, the sale concluded in December, adding to her previous real estate transaction in Silver Lake, sold at $4.2 million. Meanwhile, rumors swirl about her relationship with art dealer Caspar Jopling.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Amazon loses 240 million acres of forest, risking rainfall disruption
item.description: According to a recent report, the Amazon has lost 97 million hectares of primary forest by 2025. Most forest loss is attributed to human activity, particularly land clearing and fires. The disruptions to moisture pathways during dry seasons raise critical concerns for the ecosystem. A strong El Niño expected in late 2026 could exacerbate these issues and increase fire risks.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: North Dakota farmer to earn $5,250 a year for turning erosion-prone land into grassland
item.description: In North Dakota, a retired farmer is turning erosion-susceptible farmland into lush grassland to secure annual earnings. Through a state conservation program, he anticipates earning $5,250 over five years. This initiative encourages farmers to repurpose unproductive land, benefiting wildlife and soil health. With interest exceeding available funds, discussions are underway to seek federal assistance to enhance the program's impact on farm income and conservation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Man builds WWII-style bunker beneath his garden with 35ft tunnel and hidden beer lift
item.description: Dave Billings, a fabricator from Derbyshire, has dedicated 11 years to creating an underground garden project. His construction includes two bunkers connected by a long passage, which was inspired by World War II escape tunnels. Billings designed a lift disguised as a beer keg to facilitate drink delivery underground. He plans to connect the bunkers to his home through a concealed entrance leading to an old well.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
